t: Ultra-compact, powerful cliplight that provides precise illumination with 2x different brightness levels. Ideal for trades people, security personnel and DIYers. Can be easily attached to work clothing, caps or metal surfaces by clip or magnet. Features 360° swivel joint and swivelling lamp head. Integrated battery can be charged quickly and easily via USB-C. Also includes a low battery warning function, transport lock and a nubbed surface for a strong grip.
